name: jokbet
description: A lightweight desktop pet that counts your keyboard and mouse activity

scripts.icons: node scripts/render-sprites.ts icons src-tauri/icons/source && tauri icon src-tauri/icons/source/icon-source.png && rm -rf src-tauri/icons/android src-tauri/icons/ios
scripts.site:assets: node scripts/render-site-assets.ts gen site/assets && node scripts/build-site-pet.ts gen site/assets
scripts.site:check: node scripts/render-site-assets.ts check site/assets && node scripts/build-site-pet.ts check site/assets && node scripts/make-manifest.ts check site/latest.baked.json site/releases.baked.json
scripts.site:releases: gh api 'repos/sparkjokerben/jokbet/releases?per_page=100' | node scripts/make-manifest.ts changelog --stdin --out site/releases.baked.json
scripts.site:dev: cd site && npx --yes wrangler pages dev . --r2=DOWNLOADS
